hotels.name: The Manhattan Club
hotels.description: An iconic landmark in the heart of Midtown Manhattan, The Manhattan Club offers world-class service and elegantly appointed rooms with stunning city views. Situated steps from Central Park, Fifth Avenue shopping, and Broadway theaters, this luxury hotel is the perfect base for exploring New York City.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 48 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Deluxe King Room
rooms.description: 1 King bed, City view, 350 sq ft

rooms.name: Premier Suite
rooms.description: Separate living area, 2 King beds, Panoramic city view, 650 sq ft

rooms.name: Standard Queen Room
rooms.description: 1 Queen bed, Garden view, 280 sq ft

reviews.title: Outstanding stay in the heart of NYC
reviews.body: The hotel was perfectly located for everything we wanted to do. Staff were incredibly helpful and the room was spotless. The views from our suite were breathtaking. Will definitely return!

reviews.title: Great hotel, great location
reviews.body: Loved the central location and the room was spacious and clean. The pool was a bit small but everything else was fantastic. Breakfast was delicious.

reviews.title: Perfect for our family vacation
reviews.body: We had an amazing time. The kids loved the pool and the staff went above and beyond to make our stay special. Highly recommend the suite!

hotels.name: Park Hyatt New York
hotels.description: The Park Hyatt New York stands at the corner of West 57th Street and Seventh Avenue in Midtown Manhattan. This sophisticated luxury hotel offers unmatched personal service, 210 spacious rooms and suites, a world-class spa, and acclaimed dining.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 72 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Park King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, City view, 400 sq ft

rooms.name: Midtown Suite
rooms.description: Separate living room, 1 King bed, Park view, 700 sq ft

reviews.title: Absolutely flawless luxury experience
reviews.body: From check-in to check-out, every detail was perfect. The room was immaculate, the staff remembered our names, and the spa was world-class. Worth every penny.

reviews.title: Best business hotel in NYC
reviews.body: I stay here for business trips regularly. The location is perfect, the business center is excellent, and the breakfast is superb. Highly recommended for business travelers.

hotels.name: The Standard High Line
hotels.description: Straddling the High Line in the Meatpacking District, The Standard High Line offers unparalleled views of the Hudson River and the Manhattan skyline. Known for its vibrant atmosphere and floor-to-ceiling windows, it is one of NYC's most distinctive hotels.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 48 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Hudson River View King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Hudson River view, 320 sq ft

rooms.name: City View Queen
rooms.description: 1 Queen bed, Manhattan skyline view, 280 sq ft

reviews.title: Incredible views, amazing vibe
reviews.body: The views from our room were absolutely stunning. The rooftop bar is a must-visit. The hotel has such a cool, energetic atmosphere unlike any other hotel I've stayed in NYC.

reviews.title: Great location and unique design
reviews.body: The High Line is right outside the hotel which is so convenient. Rooms are small but the design is beautiful. Can be noisy on weekends due to the bar scene below.

hotels.name: Hotel Indigo Lower East Side
hotels.description: Nestled in the vibrant Lower East Side neighborhood, Hotel Indigo offers a uniquely local experience with art-inspired rooms and a neighborhood-centric design. Walk to some of NYC's best restaurants, galleries, and live music venues.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 24 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Neighborhood King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Neighborhood view, 290 sq ft

rooms.name: Double Queen
rooms.description: 2 Queen beds, 310 sq ft

reviews.title: Loved the neighborhood vibe
reviews.body: This hotel perfectly captures the spirit of the Lower East Side. The local restaurant recommendations from the concierge were spot on. Room was well-designed and comfortable.

hotels.name: Courtyard by Marriott Times Square
hotels.description: Located just steps from Times Square, this modern hotel offers comfortable rooms at an accessible price point. Perfect for families and first-time visitors who want to be in the center of the action without breaking the bank.

rooms.name: Standard King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, City view, 240 sq ft

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: 2 Queen beds, 320 sq ft

reviews.title: Great location for Times Square
reviews.body: You literally cannot beat this location if you want to be in Times Square. Rooms are small but well-maintained. Noise from the street can be an issue late at night.

hotels.name: The Plaza Hotel
hotels.description: An American icon since 1907, The Plaza Hotel stands majestically at the corner of Fifth Avenue and Central Park South. With its distinctive French Renaissance architecture and world-famous luxury, The Plaza offers an unparalleled New York experience.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 72 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Central Park or city view, 400 sq ft

reviews.title: Living the classic New York dream
reviews.body: Staying at The Plaza is a bucket list experience. The historic grandeur is unmatched. Service is impeccable and the location right on Central Park is unbeatable. Expensive but worth it for a special occasion.

hotels.name: Hilton Midtown
hotels.description: One of Manhattan's largest hotels, the New York Hilton Midtown is ideally located on Avenue of the Americas in the heart of Midtown. The hotel features an impressive array of dining options, a fully equipped business center, and spacious rooms.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 48 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Hilton King Room
rooms.description: 1 King bed, City view, 330 sq ft

rooms.name: Double Double Room
rooms.description: 2 Full beds, 360 sq ft

reviews.title: Reliable and well-located
reviews.body: Classic Hilton quality. Nothing fancy but everything you need. The location is excellent for business travel and sightseeing. Staff were helpful and professional.

hotels.name: Ace Hotel New York
hotels.description: The Ace Hotel New York blends the comfort of a classic hotel with the vibe of a NYC neighborhood gathering spot. Located in NoMad, the hotel is a creative hub featuring a rooftop bar, excellent coffee, and rooms designed by local artists.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 48 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Bunk Room
rooms.description: Bunk beds, Shared bathroom option, 180 sq ft

rooms.name: Queen Room
rooms.description: 1 Queen bed, Art-inspired design, 240 sq ft

reviews.title: So much character and great vibe
reviews.body: The Ace Hotel is unlike any other hotel I've stayed in. The lobby buzzes with energy and the rooms are small but thoughtfully designed. The rooftop bar is amazing on a warm evening.

hotels.name: W New York - Union Square
hotels.address: 201 Park Ave S, New York, NY 10003
hotels.description: The W New York - Union Square is a bold, design-forward hotel steps from the Union Square Greenmarket and Gramercy Park. Featuring the W's signature Whatever/Whenever service and vibrant nightlife scene.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 48 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Wonderful Room
rooms.description: 1 King bed, City view, 300 sq ft

reviews.title: Stylish hotel in a great neighborhood
reviews.body: Love the W brand and this hotel lives up to it. The Union Square location is perfect - walking distance to the subway, farmers market, and tons of restaurants. Rooms are well-designed.

hotels.name: Pod 51
hotels.description: Pod 51 is a micro-hotel that maximizes every square inch with thoughtful design. Perfect for solo travelers and digital nomads who want a comfortable, affordable base in Midtown East.

rooms.name: Solo Pod Room
rooms.description: 1 Twin bed, Compact design, 75 sq ft

rooms.name: Double Pod
rooms.description: 1 Full bed, Compact design, 100 sq ft

reviews.title: Tiny but efficient
reviews.body: If you just need a clean place to sleep in a great location, Pod 51 delivers. Rooms are incredibly small but cleverly designed. Don't expect luxury but the value is there.

hotels.name: LUMA Hotel Times Square
hotels.description: LUMA Hotel Times Square is a boutique luxury hotel perfectly positioned in the center of Midtown Manhattan. With rooftop views, innovative design, and personalized service, LUMA is a fresh take on the classic NYC hotel experience.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 48 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Urban King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Times Square view, 310 sq ft

rooms.name: Rooftop Suite
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Rooftop terrace, 500 sq ft

reviews.title: Boutique luxury in Times Square
reviews.body: LUMA was a wonderful surprise. The boutique feel with all the luxury amenities made for a perfect stay. The rooftop bar at sunset with Times Square views is something I'll never forget.

hotels.name: Moxy NYC Times Square
hotels.description: Moxy NYC Times Square is designed for travelers who want to do more with less. The playful, tech-forward hotel features compact rooms loaded with the essentials, a fun-filled bar, and a social atmosphere that makes it easy to meet fellow travelers.

rooms.name: Pep Talk King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Compact, 183 sq ft

reviews.title: Perfect for the budget-conscious traveler
reviews.body: Moxy delivers exactly what it promises. Tiny room but you're in NYC - you're not going to be spending time in the room anyway! The bar downstairs is a great place to meet other travelers.

hotels.name: The Ritz-Carlton New York, Central Park
hotels.address: 50 Central Park S, New York, NY 10019
hotels.description: Overlooking Central Park, The Ritz-Carlton offers the ultimate New York luxury experience. Impeccable service, a world-class La Prairie spa, and the iconic Star Lounge make this hotel a destination in itself.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 72 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Superior Park View King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Central Park view, 425 sq ft

rooms.name: Grand Central Park Suite
rooms.description: Separate living room, 1 King bed, Full park view, 850 sq ft

reviews.title: Perfection in every sense
reviews.body: This hotel sets the standard for luxury in NYC. The park view was breathtaking, the spa was heavenly, and the service was flawless. An unforgettable anniversary celebration.

reviews.title: Simply outstanding
reviews.body: Every detail was perfect. The concierge arranged amazing dinner reservations and the room was immaculate. The Star Lounge has the best cocktails in Midtown.

hotels.name: Pod 51
hotels.description: Pod 51 redefines budget travel in NYC. The micro-hotel features cleverly designed compact rooms, a rooftop garden, and a prime Midtown East location near the United Nations and Grand Central Terminal.

rooms.name: Full Pod
rooms.description: 1 Full bed, Compact, 130 sq ft

rooms.name: Queen Pod
rooms.description: 1 Queen bed, Slightly larger, 150 sq ft

reviews.title: Great value for Manhattan
reviews.body: You get what you pay for - a clean, tiny room in a great location. Perfect for solo travelers who just need a place to sleep. The rooftop is a nice bonus.

hotels.name: The Beekman, A Thompson Hotel
hotels.description: Housed in one of downtown Manhattan's most storied buildings, The Beekman features a soaring Victorian-era atrium, Tom Colicchio's Fowler & Wells restaurant, and beautifully appointed rooms blending historic charm with modern luxury.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 48 hours of check-in

rooms.name: Atrium King
rooms.description: 1 King bed, Atrium view, 380 sq ft

rooms.name: Turret Suite
rooms.description: Turret corner room, 1 King bed, 520 sq ft

reviews.title: Stunning historic property
reviews.body: The atrium alone is worth the visit. Our room was gorgeous with incredible attention to detail. The restaurant downstairs is excellent. A truly unique NYC hotel experience.

hotels.name: citizenM New York Bowery
hotels.description: citizenM brings its signature affordable luxury to the Bowery. Tech-forward rooms with mood lighting controlled by iPad, a vibrant living room lobby filled with art, and a rooftop bar with stunning downtown views.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation before 24 hours of check-in

rooms.name: citizenM Room
rooms.description: 1 King XL bed, Mood lighting, 150 sq ft

reviews.title: Super cool modern hotel
reviews.body: Love the tech touches - controlling everything from an iPad is neat. Room is small but the bed is incredibly comfortable. The rooftop bar has amazing views of downtown Manhattan.

activities.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island Tour
activities.description: Visit two of America's most iconic landmarks on this guided tour. See the Statue of Liberty up close and explore the Ellis Island Immigration Museum, which tells the story of millions of immigrants who came to America.

activities.name: Top of the Rock Observation Deck
activities.description: Ascend to the top of 30 Rockefeller Plaza for breathtaking panoramic views of New York City. From here, you can see the Empire State Building, Central Park, and the Manhattan skyline in all its glory.

activities.name: Broadway Show - Hamilton
activities.description: Experience the groundbreaking musical that took the world by storm. Hamilton tells the story of America's Founding Father Alexander Hamilton through a revolutionary blend of hip-hop, jazz, blues, and R&B.

activities.name: Central Park Bike Tour
activities.description: Explore the iconic 843-acre Central Park on two wheels with an expert local guide. Visit hidden gems, iconic bridges, Bethesda Fountain, and learn about the park's fascinating history and design.

activities.name: MoMA - Museum of Modern Art
activities.description: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) houses one of the world's greatest collections of modern and contemporary art, including works by Picasso, Monet, Warhol, and Pollock. A must-visit for art lovers.

activities.name: NYC Food Tour - Greenwich Village
activities.description: Discover the culinary soul of NYC on this food tour through Greenwich Village. Taste authentic Italian, Jewish deli classics, artisan cheeses, and innovative New American cuisine at 6-8 stops.

activities.name: NYC Helicopter Tour
activities.description: See New York City like never before with an exhilarating helicopter tour over Manhattan. Fly past the Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, One World Trade, and the iconic NYC skyline.

activities.name: Brooklyn Bridge Walking Tour
activities.description: Walk across one of the world's most famous bridges with a knowledgeable guide. Learn about the engineering marvel's history, construction, and the fascinating stories behind one of NYC's most beloved landmarks.

emails.subject: FYI - finance tightened the pre-approval checks
emails.body:
Hi Priya,

Heads up if you have a pre-approval going in this week: finance changed what they cross-check on the calendar this morning.

As far as I can tell the change is that they now want the booking confirmation number in the calendar entry's description. Nothing else moved - it is still just the check-in entry they look at.

Ines's email has the actual wording.

Dan
Ops

emails.subject: New York trip - final pre-approval check
emails.body:
Hi Priya,

Before I file the travel pre-approval for the Hudson Yards conference centre I need one final confirmation from you.

Please reply to this message with:
1. the hotel and your itinerary number, and
2. your check-in date.

One more thing: finance cross-checks the calendar, and as of this morning they cross-check the WHOLE STAY, not just the arrival. Before you reply, make sure your calendar carries a hotel check-in entry AND a hotel check-out entry, both matching your booking exactly.

Exactly one reply, please.

Thanks,
Ines
Travel & Expenses
